opening.argument: The description promises a “100% working” method to claim unlimited free cryptocurrency and tells viewers to enter the displayed codes in Binance. That promise is paired with concrete instructions, reinforced by a screen prompting users to enter a code to claim a Red Packet. The solicitation extends to a Telegram channel, a referral link, and comments containing viewers’ Binance Pay IDs for a chance at a gift. Together, these establish a deceptive free-crypto solicitation that creates potential data or referral flows, rather than merely discussing a third-party scam.
